newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks fall sharply amid selling of futures.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks fall sharply amid selling of futures.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended sharply lower on Wednesday as unravelling of arbitrage-linked positions took their toll on cash stocks, brokers said.
They said trade was thin to begin with, which helped to magnify the losses.
By the end of the session the 225-share Nikkei average was down 291.27 points or 1.57 percent at 18,273.51. Its March futures lost 280 points to finish at 18,300.
"Uncertainties over what state the economy will be in in the new fiscal year and how reforms will be carried out are casting shadows," said Yamaichi Securities general manager Tadahiro Kamogawa.
